description: The state is exploring a new route and bridge across the Chesapeake Bay. A study led by the Maryland Transportation Authority (MDTA) released three potential routes. Shockingly, one of those routes includes MD100 through Mountain Road to a bridge that crosses the bay at the end of Mountain Road. This plan will devastate our community […]
title: Kipke Launches Petition to Oppose Mountain Road Bay Bridge - Nic Kipke
